# get_on_ramp_payment_limits()

**Qualified name:** `pyrogram.Client.get_on_ramp_payment_limits`

## Signature

```python
async def get_on_ramp_payment_limits(
    provider_id: str,
    cryptocurrency: str,
    base_currency: str,
    payment_method_name: Optional[str] = None
) -> 'types.OnRampPaymentLimits': ...
```

## Documentation

Get the limits of an on-ramp payment.

Only for providers with [`OnRampProvider`](../../types/wallet/OnRampProvider.md) *supports_limits*.

**Available to:** User accounts.

### Parameters

- **`provider_id`** (`str`)
  Unique identifier of the on-ramp provider.

- **`cryptocurrency`** (`str`)
  The cryptocurrency that will be bought.

- **`base_currency`** (`str`)
  ISO 4217 code of the currency that will be used for the purchase.

- **`payment_method_name`** (`str`, *optional*)
  Name of the chosen payment method, if any.

### Returns

[`OnRampPaymentLimits`](../../types/wallet/OnRampPaymentLimits.md): On success, the limits are returned.

### Example

```python
limits = await app.get_on_ramp_payment_limits(provider.id, "TON", "USD")
```
